# Brazilian Equities: Post-Election Update

Report 097 | Published 2022-11-16 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2022-11-16/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/097.json)

Brazil after elections and FTX after failure.

Gold bottom, slowing hikes, tax-revenue weakness and Bitcoin's three-year direction were supported. The 2023 recession and Apple multi-year-high ceiling failed; Tesla's record took just over two years to recover. Value and megacap calls face strong contrary return evidence, though their timing was vague. FTX fraud and unbacked liabilities were accurately diagnosed, while US regulation was overstated as protection from customer-fund misuse. Brazil's transfer succeeded amid serious violence; the local rate peak and earnings/dividend observations were useful, while its decade investment case remains open. Current text includes same-day Genesis developments, and publication-vintage authentication is unavailable.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

## Framework lessons

- Separate custody failures from protocol failures.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
